courses.title: Yoga for Pain Relief
courses.description: An eight-episode online course drawn from his book Gravity & Grace, sent all at once with a digital workbook. It first softens the holding patterns the body forms under stress, then uses gravity and breath to rebuild mobility and strength, working region by region from hands and feet to head and neck.

courses.title: G&G2 | MARMA Ball Therapy (download, 35m)
courses.description: A 35-minute video download from the Gravity & Grace 2 series using two tennis balls for self-massage on marma, the pressure points of Indian tradition. Lying on the balls lets gravity do the work of finding and releasing held muscular tension.
